verdict.rationale: Snyk runs automations such as fix PRs, the Remediation Agent and Studio hooks, so versioning, reviewing and rolling them back is a fair axis for this product. The pack, however, never documents version history, change review or rollback for those automations or their policies. Pushing IaC custom-rule bundles to OCI registries is distribution of developer-built rules, and human-in-the-loop fix review concerns code fixes rather than the automations themselves, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
